title: EXP-401 definition creation accepts invalid process graphs
notes: Cluster F from the final integration run: TC-EXP-401-02/03/04/05 expected error.GraphValidationFailed, but definition creation succeeded for invalid graphs. Evidence: _integration_final.log lines 42353-42497.
root_cause: src/definition/graph.zig defines validateCompensationHandlers() and validateReversibility(), both already returning correct typed violations, but neither was ever called from src/definition/store.zig's three graph-mutating paths (create/promote/update) — only validateGraph/validateNodeAttributes/validateEdgeConditions/validateEdgeTransforms ran before persistence. Secondary bug: parseErrorBoundaryConfig() rejected empty on_error_event/on_cancel_event strings as error.InvalidInput before validateCompensationHandlers()'s ERROR_BOUNDARY_EVENTS_MISSING check could run, making that check unreachable dead code. (Investigated and ruled out: tests/integration/exp401_exp402_comp_restore_test.zig is NOT missing from build.zig — it is reached indirectly via tests/integration/main_test.zig's existing @import + pin, per the ISS-0137/GH-439 pattern, and was already executed under zig build test-integration all along.)
candidate_resolution: Run canonical graph validation before any definition persistence, propagate typed GraphValidationFailed errors, and ensure all invalid graph classes leave no stored definition or side effects.
resolution: store.zig: added calls to validateCompensationHandlers() and validateReversibility() in create(), promote(), and update(), in the same pre-DB-write fail-fast position as the existing four validation stages. graph.zig: parseErrorBoundaryConfig() now lets empty on_error_event/on_cancel_event strings parse through so the specific ERROR_BOUNDARY_EVENTS_MISSING violation fires instead of the generic ERROR_BOUNDARY_INVALID. build.zig: added a new narrow test-integration-exp401-exp402 step for fast iteration on this one file (convenience only — the file's tests were already reachable via main_test.zig's @import and ran under the full test-integration umbrella beforehand). Verified via zig build test-integration-exp401-exp402 (7/7 pass, including previously-failing TC-EXP-401-02/03/04/05), zig build test (exit 0), zig build migrate (exit 0), lint_sql_param_types.py (0 BLOCKER/MAJOR).
prevention: When adding a new graph-validation function to graph.zig, grep store.zig's three graph-mutating paths (create/promote/update) to confirm the new function is actually called in all three — a validator that compiles and has correct logic but is never invoked produces no compile error and no test failure until a test specifically exercises it.

When checking whether a tests/integration/*.zig file is wired into the build, grep tests/integration/main_test.zig's @import list (and any other umbrella root) in addition to build.zig itself — files are commonly wired in indirectly via an @import + `_ = x;` pin in main_test.zig (ISS-0137/GH-439 pattern) rather than getting their own build.zig b.addTest entry. Grepping build.zig alone gives a false negative.
